new.s: In the context of Andhra Pradesh's bifurcation, the 'resource gap' for the first post-bifurcation year refers to:
o: The fiscal deficit of the State for the full financial year 2014-15
The revenue deficit (revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts) for the first ten months
The shortfall in capital outlay compared with the 13th Finance Commission projection
The difference between borrowings and repayments for 2014-15
new.x: The resource gap was defined as the revenue deficit, i.e. revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts, for the first ten months (2 June 2014 to 31 March 2015). It is not the full-year fiscal deficit, a capital-outlay shortfall or a net borrowing figure.
new.tq: Resource gap = revenue deficit, first 10 months.

new.s: According to the APPSC answer key, the resource gap of Andhra Pradesh in the bifurcation year was:

Between Rs 10,000 crore and Rs 12,000 crore
new.x: The APPSC-GS 2022 key puts the bifurcation-year gap at more than Rs 15,000 crore (the State itself claimed Rs 16,078 crore). The lower ranges match only the Union Finance Ministry's narrower assessment of about Rs 4,118 crore or are unsupported.

new.s: Under Section 85(2) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, the headquarters of the river management boards are located as follows:
o: KRMB in Telangana and GRMB in Andhra Pradesh
Both KRMB and GRMB in New Delhi
KRMB in Andhra Pradesh and GRMB in Telangana
Both KRMB and GRMB in Andhra Pradesh
new.x: Sec. 85(2) places the KRMB headquarters in Andhra Pradesh and the GRMB headquarters in Telangana. The reversed pairing is the common trap; neither New Delhi nor a single State hosts both.
new.tq: Krishna Board in AP, Godavari Board in TG.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh asked the Centre to notify the jurisdiction of the Krishna River Management Board under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: Sec. 87 gives the Boards jurisdiction over projects notified by the Centre, and AP sought such notification for KRMB (APPSC-GS 2021 key). Sec. 84 is the Apex Council, Sec. 90 Polavaram as national project, Sec. 94 fiscal/industrial incentives.

new.s: The Polavaram Irrigation Project was declared a national project under which section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
